skill.name: docs-architect
skill.description: Creates comprehensive technical documentation from existing codebases. Analyzes architecture, design patterns, and implementation details to produce long-form technical manuals and ebooks.
skill.summary: Generates structured technical manuals and architecture documentation from existing codebases.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: I reviewed the single static finding and determined it is a false positive. The flagged Markdown backticks on SKILL.md line 24 wrap a file path reference, not shell execution. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: The snippet uses Markdown inline backticks around a referenced documentation path, not Ruby or shell command execution. SKILL.md contains prompt guidance only, with no executable code or command invocation.

content.value_statement: Complex codebases are hard to explain when architecture knowledge stays inside the source tree. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to create structured technical manuals from real implementation details.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes code structure, dependencies, components, and relationships to build documentation plans.
Organizes long-form Markdown manuals with chapters, sections, cross-references, tables, and code blocks.
Explains architecture, design decisions, data models, integrations, deployment, performance, and security topics.
Creates audience-specific reading paths for developers, architects, and operations teams.
Describes architecture, sequence, and flow diagrams for inclusion in documentation.
limitations: Needs access to code and project context to produce accurate documentation.
Does not replace review by system owners, security reviewers, or operations teams.
May need clarification when inputs, scope, permissions, or success criteria are unclear.
The referenced implementation playbook is not bundled in this package.

use_cases.title: Prepare Architecture Manuals
use_cases.description: Turn a codebase review into a structured manual for design reviews, planning, and long-term maintenance.

use_cases.title: Build Onboarding Guides
use_cases.description: Create progressive reading paths that help new engineers understand components, data flows, and operational concerns.

use_cases.title: Document Operational Interfaces
use_cases.description: Explain APIs, events, dependencies, deployment architecture, and troubleshooting paths for platform handoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Map the Repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a starter architecture overview for this repository. Identify major components, responsibilities, and the best reading order for new developers.

prompt_templates.title: Draft the Manual Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the codebase and draft a Markdown documentation outline. Include chapters for architecture, data models, integrations, deployment, and troubleshooting.

prompt_templates.title: Explain Design Decisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this service and write the design decision section. Explain why key patterns were chosen and link claims to relevant files and lines.

prompt_templates.title: Produce the Full Manual
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a comprehensive technical manual for this system. Include audience paths, component deep dives, diagram descriptions, operational notes, and validation gaps.

output_examples.input: A monorepo needs onboarding documentation for new backend engineers.
output: Repository overview with service boundaries and ownership notes.
Reading path from entry points to core domain modules.
Glossary, common workflows, and maintenance checklist.

output_examples.input: An API service needs architecture documentation before a review.
output: Executive summary for reviewers and stakeholders.
Component map with request flow and integration points.
Design decision section with rationale and tradeoffs.

output_examples.input: A legacy platform needs long-term maintenance documentation.
output: Current-state architecture manual with known constraints.
Operational guidance for deployment and troubleshooting.
Appendices for data models, dependencies, and open questions.

best_practices: Provide repository access, target audience, and documentation goals before generation.
Ask for file and line references when the documentation makes implementation claims.
Review generated security, deployment, and performance sections with responsible owners.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for unrelated writing tasks that do not require technical documentation.
Requesting definitive architecture claims without giving codebase access or project context.
Publishing generated manuals without checking accuracy against the current implementation.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates long-form technical documentation, including architecture overviews, component explanations, design rationale, and operational sections.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it inspect code automatically?
faq.answer: It guides the active agent to analyze available code and project context. Accuracy depends on the access you provide.

faq.question: Can it create diagrams?
faq.answer: It can describe architecture, sequence, and flow diagrams for inclusion in documentation.

faq.question: Is the output ready to publish?
faq.answer: Use it as a strong draft. Review implementation claims, security notes, and operational details before publishing.

faq.question: When should I avoid this skill?
faq.answer: Avoid it when the task is not documentation-focused or when required inputs and success criteria are missing.
